verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Registrar exposes a Registrar API for searching, checking, registering, and managing domains, which could be scripted to perform actions across multiple domains, but there is no explicit documentation of dedicated bulk endpoints (e.g., bulk transfer, bulk renew, bulk WHOIS update) or UI bulk-select tooling. missing for 10: explicit bulk API operations/documentation, dashboard bulk-select actions, evidence of AI-native automation using the API at scale.
